visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network diagram. Left column: 3 purple filled circles (input layer). Middle column: 3 hidden units, each a light-green box containing Sigma symbol followed by a pale-yellow box containing a sigmoid-like activation glyph; label 'Net' sits above each. Right column: 3 output units in the same Sigma+activation style, labeled 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output 3' to their right. Further right: text labels 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. Far right: vertical red bar with 'Error Error Error' written vertically. Blue arrows connect every input to every hidden unit and every hidden unit to every output unit. Bottom of diagram: 'Input' label with an upward arrow, a green circle containing '1', a purple/pink circle containing '?', and 'Neural Net' label at bottom-left. Small green upward arrows appear near the bottom.
Yellow circular badge containing the slide number 18 in black text
White mouse cursor arrow pointing upper-left
Dark red rectangular border framing the entire slide

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0). 2. Add a dark red (#8B0000) thin rectangular border around the entire slide edge. 3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at the top-right (approx. x=88%, y=8%) with the text '18' in large black bold sans-serif. 4. In the upper-center region (approx. x=22–78%, y=8–48%), build the neural network diagram: (a) draw 3 purple (#800080) filled circles in a vertical column on the left for the input layer; (b) to their right, place 3 hidden units, each consisting of a light-green (#90EE90) rectangle with 'Σ' followed by a pale-yellow (#FFFACD) rectangle with a sigmoid-like squiggle, and add the label 'Net' above each; (c) to the right, place 3 output units in the same Sigma+activation style and label them 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output 3'; (d) draw blue (#0000FF) arrows from every input node to every hidden unit and from every hidden unit to every output unit; (e) add text labels 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' to the right of the outputs; (f) add a vertical red (#FF0000) bar on the far right with 'Error Error Error' written vertically; (g) at the bottom, add 'Input' with an upward arrow, a green (#008000) circle with '1', a purple/pink circle with '?', and 'Neural Net' at the bottom-left. 5. On the right side (approx. x=80%, y=25–38%), add the equation '∂E/∂w_{ji} ?' in large bold black text. 6. Optionally add a white mouse cursor arrow in the lower-right (approx. x=78%, y=75%) to match the video frame exactly.
